d: Watch the match highlights and all goals from Brazil vs Japan in the Round of 32 of the FIFA World Cup 2026 at Houston Stadium in Houston, Texas. After Kaishu Sano put Japan ahead in the 29th minute, Casemiro leveled with a 56th-minute header from a Gabriel Magalhães delivery before substitute Gabriel Martinelli struck in the 90+6th minute off a Bruno Guimarães pass to seal a 2-1 comeback win for Brazil.
